energy: energy(X)=Re tr(X* X)=sum abs(X)^2; Euclidean/Frobenius squared norm, not full electromagnetic energy
physics: L(m)=I-diag(m)G; j(m)=L(m)^-1 diag(m)E0; 3D m is repeated per vector component

basis.complex: right singular basis of raw Gin=G and Gob=S
basis.real_material_control: right singular basis of vertically stacked [Re A;Im A]
basis.vector_material_control: dm repeated per voxel component and divided by sqrt(3); isometric but arbitrary coordinate lift, not material Jacobian or observability

twofold.sequential_scope: Each order sums squared component energies to total; components across different cells need not all be orthogonal; not intersections
twofold.numerical_intersection: Q_ab orthonormal basis of ker(V_ob,b_perp*V_in,a), lifted into V_in,a
twofold.overlapping_projected_spans: orth(P_ob,b V_in,a), absolute rank cutoff1e-10; energies can sum beyond100%
twofold.propagated_cross: signed_cross_energy=||A X||^2-sum_ab ||A X_ab||^2 at tau.1, includes all pair cross terms; isolated component output energies are not a unique output partition

actual_affine.JD: Vd diag(sigma_d)^-1 Ud*Y using actual frozen rank per run
actual_affine.U: (I-VdVd*)F_mf with exact native orthonormal IFFT frequency mask and vector component order
actual_affine.identity: ||J_aux-jGT||^2=||jGT-J_proj||^2+||J_aux-J_proj||^2 when J_aux belongs to the saved affine family
actual_affine.scope: Only auxiliary J constrained. m-derived physical and corrector currents can be outside, so no final recovery lower bound

attribution: Paired absolute_band_energy_reduction=ordinary band squared error minus A+ band squared error. Positive=improvement. Percentage shifts alone do not establish absolute error improvement.
GT_status: EXPOSED_OFFLINE_DIAGNOSTIC; no optimization, online GT, new inverse data, GT-based state/rank/mf selection
operator_provenance: New SVD per exact G/S group. Grouping requires np.array_equal on full matrices. No reuse of GN reference spectra.
sparse_state_scope: Only actually saved initial, stage_joint, pre-corrector selected/raw, prediction. No reconstructed hidden trajectory or dense interpolation.
